verdict.rationale: The docs show that customers can be companies, and that customers are screened against sanctions, watchlists, PEP and adverse-media data. That covers screening business entities. Nothing in the pack shows linked ownership, UBO or association-network risk context that an analyst can inspect. Missing for 10: documented ownership/beneficial-owner or association linkage for screened entities, a way to inspect related-party risk, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
